Drop your information below, and we’ll be in touch with details on how to bring Red Ball Tennis to your community.

*By clicking JOIN THE FUN, you are signing up to receive email communications from USTA and its affiliates about Red Ball Tennis play opportunities, programs and other promotional communications. You agree to and understand that personal information you provide will be used as described in . You must be 13 years of age or older to subscribe to these communications.
